headline: A rose 29.91% on low volume while revised Q3 filings and multiple unusual-trading alerts across CONS and PROP require priority review.
market_take: Coverage is mixed, led by A at +29.91% and EVER at +25.00%, while PF fell 20.00%. CONS shows the clearest unusual activity: PLE, CIVIL and WGE posted large price moves with elevated volume, and TPOLY's price gap and intraday move coincided with revised Q3 earnings filings. There were 52 unusual-trading alerts in total, with 20 high alerts shown.

sector_notes.note: A gained 29.91% despite volume at 0.11 times average and was covered by revised Q3 earnings filings. EVER rose 25.00%, while PF fell 20.00%; PRECHA also reported a high-significance CB sign posting.

PLE fell 16.67% on volume at 12.98 times and had a -16.67% open gap and 25.8σ volume spike. CIVIL fell 12.09% and WGE rose 9.68%, both with volume above 12 times and high volume-spike readings; TPOLY also filed revised Q3 results.
AQUA rose 11.11% on modest volume at 1.09 times, matching an unusual intraday-move alert. CFRESH showed a 10.9σ volume spike and a +9.15% open gap, while AAI and PQS also had material volume spikes.
SKN rose 7.39% on volume at 8.17 times, the strongest CONMAT move in the digest. DCON fell 6.67% and EPG 6.03%.
UVAN registered a 5.6σ volume spike, making it the notable AGRI name to monitor.
